episodes.title: How do we study our minds?
episodes.description: Introduce psychology’s investigation of human experience.

episodes.title: The Roots of Psychology
episodes.description: Trace major schools of psychological thought and explore historical views of mental illness and asylums.

episodes.title: How Psychologists Research People
episodes.description: Psychology is a science, and like other scientists, psychologists conduct research in a variety of ways.

episodes.title: Is Psychology Unbiased?
episodes.description: A lot of psychology assumes that a researcher is unbiased, except... no one is totally unbiased.

episodes.title: Getting to Know Your Brain
episodes.description: Explore biological psychology’s current knowledge and unresolved questions.

episodes.title: How Our (More Than) Five Senses Work
episodes.description: Understanding how our senses work gives us valuable insight into how our experiences are alike and different.

episodes.title: Our Different States of Consciousness
episodes.description: Whether we’re awake, asleep, actively dreaming, or experiencing a caffeine boost of energy, our bodies have many states of consciousness.

episodes.title: What Even Is Learning?
episodes.description: Explore learning as a process that extends beyond formal education.

episodes.title: How to Utilize Your Memory
episodes.description: Let’s explore what researchers have learned about the ways memory can fail us and how this knowledge can help us respect and value memory.

episodes.title: Can you measure intelligence?
episodes.description: Examine different ways psychologists understand and describe intelligence.

episodes.title: What drives our goals?
episodes.description: Explore the motivations behind human behavior.

episodes.title: Where Do Emotions Come From?
episodes.description: Examine emotions, including their origins and the ways people express them.

episodes.title: Stages of Human Development
episodes.description: From birth to adolescence to elderhood, human life consists of a variety of stages and skills and milestones.

episodes.title: Influences on Development
episodes.description: Explore the different forces that influence human development.

episodes.title: Unpacking Gender and Sexuality
episodes.description: In this episode, you’ll learn more about the terms associated with gender and sexuality and how society shapes our understanding of these concepts.

episodes.title: Do You Really Know Your Personality?
episodes.description: All cultures ask questions about what makes one person’s personality different from someone else’s, and where those differences come from.

episodes.title: The Psychology of Stress
episodes.description: Stress is an inherent part of life that can’t be avoided, but that doesn’t mean that we’re always successful dealing with it.

episodes.title: What is health psychology?
episodes.description: Explore how psychological states and behavior interact with illness, injury, and physical symptom management.

episodes.title: Health psychology and chronic disease
episodes.description: Understanding which risk factors for disease are or aren’t in our control can help us have a realistic outlook on our health.

episodes.title: How positive psychology can make us happier
episodes.description: Explore psychological research on happiness and its wider effects.

episodes.title: Treating the Whole Person
episodes.description: Compare approaches to treating the whole person, including complementary and alternative medical practices.

episodes.title: Diagnosing and Defining Disorders
episodes.description: In this episode, we’ll take a look at how psychologists diagnose and define disorders.

episodes.title: TikTok Diagnoses vs Psychologist Diagnoses
episodes.description: Psychologists diagnose psychological disorders based on specific patterns of thoughts and behaviors.

episodes.title: Substance Use Disorders
episodes.description: In this episode of Study Hall: Intro to Psychology, we’ll learn more about substance use disorders and how they can be treated.

episodes.title: How do we Navigate Grief?
episodes.description: And grief can be a long and complicated process, so psychologists have identified some patterns and models to explain and help people navigate grief.

episodes.title: Paths of Psychology
episodes.description: Within the field of psychology, there are many different career paths that require different kinds of education and experience.

episodes.title: The Many Roads to Mental Health
episodes.description: In this episode, we’ll look at a variety of ways mental health professionals can work toward healing with patients.

episodes.title: The Standing Rock Protest and Social Psychology
episodes.description: Examine social patterns through the example of protests against the Dakota Access Pipeline.

episodes.title: Social Influences
episodes.description: In this episode, we’ll take a closer look at all the different ways people influence each other in group settings.

episodes.title: How can psychology be more inclusive?
episodes.description: Explore efforts to make psychology more inclusive and representative, and the work that remains.
